summary: A genuinely mutual NDA on the counterparty's paper whose terms track the Halyard playbook closely, with no clear deviations.

findings.quote: disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of one Party (the "Discloser") to the other Party (the "Recipient")
findings.why: Discloser and Recipient are defined so either party can be either, and obligations apply to the Recipient generally.

findings.quote: whether marked as confidential or that reasonably ought to be understood as confidential given its content or the circumstances of disclosure
findings.why: Covers marked information or information reasonably understood as confidential, which is the preferred test.

findings.quote: use Confidential Information solely to evaluate and pursue the Permitted Purpose and for no other reason
findings.why: Use is limited solely to exploring a potential collaborative and commercial relationship.

findings.quote: is already in or enters the public domain without any breach of this Agreement
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present (public domain, already known, third party, independently developed) with no narrowing beyond a demonstrate standard.

findings.quote: except to those of its Representatives who need to know it for the Permitted Purpose, provided such Representatives are bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as strict as those in this Agreement
findings.why: Need-to-know disclosure to employees, officers, advisers, auditors and group affiliates with recipient liability under 2.1.4; insurers are not listed but advisers and auditors are permitted.

findings.quote: where lawful to do so, the Recipient shall promptly notify the Discloser in writing
findings.why: Disclosure is permitted where required by law, court or regulator, with notice only where lawful and cooperation at the Discloser's expense.

findings.quote: The Recipient may keep copies of Confidential Information to the extent required by applicable law, regulatory compliance or automated electronic system backups created in the ordinary course of business.
findings.why: Return or destroy on request with a ten business day confirmation and an exception for legal copies and automated backups that stay confidential.

findings.quote: Neither this Agreement nor any disclosure grants the Recipient any licence, title or intellectual property right in or to any Confidential Information, except the limited right to use it strictly for the Permitted Purpose.
findings.why: Information stays with the Discloser and no licence is granted beyond use for the Purpose.

findings.quote: Information is shared on an "as is" basis without warranty of any kind regarding accuracy or completeness.
findings.why: Mutual as-is and no-warranty position with no fraud carve-out removed and no Halyard warranty given.

findings.quote: Neither Party will issue any press release or public statement mentioning the other Party or the discussions between them without prior written approval.
findings.why: Mutual publicity restriction requiring prior written approval.

findings.quote: remains in effect for two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party giving thirty (30) days' prior written notice
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' notice to terminate early, as preferred.

findings.quote: continues for three (3) years after the date of termination or expiry, except that trade secrets remain protected for as long as they constitute a trade secret under applicable law
findings.why: Three-year survival with trade secrets protected while they remain trade secrets.

findings.quote: each Party is entitled to seek injunctive relief and specific performance to prevent or remedy any actual or threatened breach
findings.why: Mutual right to seek injunctive and equitable relief with no bond requirement or liquidated damages.

findings.quote: Neither Party may assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.why: No assignment by either party without prior written consent, the preferred position.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales
the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction
findings.why: Exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales, the preferred position.

findings.quote: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties relating to this subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions and understandings.
findings.why: Customary entire-agreement wording that does not exclude liability for fraud; third-party rights are excluded in 8.7.
